correctness.rationale: The additive decomposition X=xI+[[u1,u2],[u3,0]] and analogous Y is valid even in characteristic two. Commuting iff the two three-vectors have all 2x2 minors zero, so the scalar sums force both traces to vanish. Row/column invariance gives a Smith normal form for frequency W, and exact primitive-vector hyperplane-annihilator sums give Smith-stratum Fourier multipliers, with zero exactly when s+t<=k-2 for t<k; the t=k cases remain positive. Thus nonzero support is exactly the pullback of rank<=1 congruence modulo pi^(k-1). Counting primitive vectors in the lower-length cone yields (q²+q+1)q^(4k)−(q+1)q^(3k+1). Independently exact-Walsh-enumerated all 4096 quotient Fourier coefficients over F2[t]/t², yielding 1408 nonzeros and each predicted Smith multiplier. Ring-universal claim follows from exact annihilator/Smith proof, not enumeration.
